title: Nutty Crispy Ukrainian Turmeric Pilaf
description: A post-workout vegetarian dish featuring turmeric and nuts, cooked on a Bichoton grill for a crispy texture and rich flavor.

ingredients.name: Ukra偃山茶
ingredients.notes: Use the correct name for a type of tea

instructions: Heat a Bichoton grill to medium-high.
Soak the Ukra偃山茶 for about an hour and then steep it in hot water for about 5 minutes. Strain out any residue and set aside.
Trim and dice the carrots into small pieces, finely chop the onion, and crush the cashews lightly.
In a pan, sauté the onions with turmeric powder until fragrant, add garlic powder, salt, and stir well for 2 minutes.
Add the soaked Ukra偃山茶 to the pan along with diced carrots and chopped onions. Stir thoroughly and cook for about 5 minutes more.
Preheat the Bichoton grill to high heat and lightly grease it with coconut oil.
Divide the carrot mixture evenly onto both halves of the grilled surface, spreading out in a thin layer.
Once hot, place the cashews on top of the pilaf mixture. Keep the fire under control to avoid burning.
Cook until the nut coating turns golden brown and crispy, about 3-5 minutes per side. The dish should be perfectly cooked when it’s evenly charred with a nice crunchy texture.
Remove from heat and serve immediately.
